test_title: PYST 41: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 24 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**__Direction__: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

I felt terribly **__jaded__ **after working all weekend.
solution:
The correct answer is **'refreshed'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jaded **is an adjective that means bored or lacking
